result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical accessibility problem with low-contrast heart icons and a major layout problem in the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: Heart icons (favorite buttons) in the 'Popular right now' section (e.g., on the ramen and pizza cards) use black outlines on dark backgrounds, resulting in insufficient color contrast for visibility. This hinders usability for users with visual impairments or color blindness.
issues.suggestion: Change the heart icon's color to a lighter shade (e.g., white) to ensure sufficient contrast against the dark background, making the icon clearly visible.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar has misaligned or overlapping icons/labels. The shopping bag icon appears misplaced, overlapping with the search icon’s area or text, disrupting the visual layout and usability of the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom navigation bar’s layout to properly space and align all icons/labels, ensuring no overlap and a clear visual hierarchy for each navigation element.
